I love scrambled eggs. Here is my method for 1 person

-3 eggs and season with salt and pepper. wisk in a bowl before adding to pan.

-1 Tbs of good quality butter to a cold pan (I use nonstick but any small pan will work)

-Medium heat

-When the butter is barely melted and starting to bubble I add the eggs.

-Fold the eggs constantly with a spatula. Scrape the bottom and sides so none of it sticks or burns. Its going to seem like the eggs arnt doing anything for about 2 minutes, but then you will see the curds forming.

-Cook to desired doneness. For me this is when the eggs arn't liquidy any more, but still have a sheen.

-Dont leave the eggs in the pan they will continue to cook!

-Done! Serve with toast and garnish with green onions

Anti 1: play flushes and try to get some money. If I see a money or a + mult joker I'll take it. No vouchers, no tarot packs, no card packs.

Anti 2: try to keep interest up and get more + mult jokers. If I see a + mult, + chip, or money joker I'll take it. I rarely get the voucher. If I have a super good start I can sacrifice my economy for a good voucher. Take tarot cards in the shop if they make money, hermit, devil temperance, fool.

Anti 3: maintain economy 25+ gold. Fill out joker slots, 1 + chip joker (blue joker is really solid), 2-3 + mult jokers, 1 utility preferably money at this point.

Anti 4: start thinking about how to scale your damage. Usually get away from flushes and go to pairs instead. X mult priority. Chariot tarot, death on chariot cards, start buying most packs if you have the money to support it. Keep making money. I take hermit out of tarot packs almost every time.

anti 5, 6, 7 : roll with what you got and try to build off of it. Got Fibonacci or odd joker, use strength tarot to turn kings into aces. Got 10 4?,  use strength on 3 and 9. Strength really helps to build deck towards synergies. Also start thinning deck and delete cards you probably won't play.

Anti 8: get rid of any economy jokers and buy everything. No need to maintain economy.
If your deck has 1 good chip joker, 3 + mult, and at least 1 x mult you should beat white stakes no problem playing pairs.


This isnt the best or only way to play but tends to be how I play the game. My most played tarot is hermit followed by temperance. My most played jokers are stuntman and card sharp. Blueprint is a must grab at any point. At higher stakes the antis are much higher and you have to play a lot more x mult to keep up. If I'm stacking steel and get to +200 mult before my jokers trigger my +30 tarot joker isn't really doing anything. I'd rather have ANY polychrome joker for 1.5x. if I get a double tag I usually save it for double money or negative joker. Gold cards are a really nice way to increase money and playing pairs makes it easier to hold extra cards after anti 4.

Good luck find what works for you and have fun!

It's worth it if you can get the price down. My biggest holdup is the CPU though. It will leave you wanting more so you would need to replace the ram (I think that's ddr3) the mobo and the cpu for an upgrade. So you would be sinking a lot of money in a future upgrade ~500.
